title: The Silent Alarm
scene: At 8:15 AM, the hardware store alarm panel was swapped. The back office was locked during the morning stocktake.

suspects.name: Vera Nolan
suspects.testimony: I was counting stock in the aisle at 8:15, clipboard in hand.
suspects.alibiProof: The stock sheet shows Vera's initials at 8:12 and 8:19.

suspects.name: Dane Pike
suspects.testimony: I was at the panel at 8:15, testing the wiring.
suspects.contradiction: The panel was sealed by stocktake locks, and a spare cover was in Dane's toolbox.

suspects.name: Mira Cole
suspects.testimony: I was at register one at 8:15.
suspects.alibiProof: The register camera shows Mira at 8:13 and 8:17.

suspects.name: Otto Reed
suspects.testimony: I was unloading boxes at the side door at 8:15.
suspects.alibiProof: The delivery scan records Otto at 8:14.
